node.statement: Assembly: let M be any compact smooth manifold without boundary. Node 1.1 supplies a complex K and a C^1 triangulation f:K→M; node 1.2 identifies f as a homeomorphism |K|→M; node 1.3 gives compactness of |K|; and node 1.4 then makes K a finite simplicial complex. Hence M is homeomorphic to the finite simplicial complex K, which is the root conclusion.
